svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.cube-net-six-face-example", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "Trace six equal18mm-square faces and five shared full-edge fold hinges. Four faces form a strip;the other two are on opposite sides of its second face. Abstract ninety-degree folding gives six distinct face normals and eight cube vertices. Outer edge1.4mm;hinges1mm dashed in line media and sparser native dots in Index. Use a real cube and separate folding material;this graphic has no glue tabs and physical folding/touch recognition remain untested. Other valid layouts are variants of this same net meaning.", "geometry_exception": "Swell/ViewPlus share1.4mm outer boundaries and1mm dashed fold hinges. Native1.2mm Index dots use denser outer boundaries and sparser fold references with explicit junction guards. Cylinder end circles separated6mm from rectangular lateral surface for tactile clarity,not attached paper hinges. All alternatives stay in the same master;no exact source reconstruction.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}

g.data-exception-reason: Native1.2mm graphic dots,notBraille. All logical vertices retain single dots;outer boundaries are denser than approximately8mm fold-reference pitch. Deliberate near-junction guards prevent clusters. All-pairs clearance checked;actual tactile continuity remains pending.
